blurb.es: Argent Flow de carry en un equipo entre físico y de Arts: Chen Qianyu pone la Vulnerability, Arcane suma Electric Infliction con su Combo y Liino cura y sube el ATK. Dos vueltas iguales y un burst en el que Bolt Rush, tras la Electrification de la Ultimate de Liino, llega al nivel 4. Según el autor, la más fácil de sus dos rotaciones con este equipo (dificultad 1/5, daño 3,5/5) y un buen paso entre los equipos de Arcane y los físicos.
blurb.en: Argent Flow as carry in a team between physical and Arts: Chen Qianyu supplies Vulnerability, Arcane adds Electric Infliction with her Combo and Liino heals and raises ATK. Two identical loops and a burst where Bolt Rush, after the Electrification from Liino's Ultimate, reaches level 4. Per the author, the easier of their two rotations for this team (difficulty 1/5, damage 3.5/5) and a good bridge between Arcane teams and physical ones.

whatItDoes.es: La Battle Skill y el Combo de Chen ponen Vulnerability, que abre el Combo de Argent Flow: una Electric Infliction, que el Combo de Arcane (forma WILL) repite. Bolt Rush consume las dos y deja Electrification de nivel 3 y 3 de Sunderization; esa Electrification abre el Combo de Liino. En el burst, la Ultimate y el Combo de Arcane suman cargas, la Ultimate de Liino pone Electrification antes de Bolt Rush y el Crush de la Ultimate de Argent Flow detona la Sunderization.
whatItDoes.en: Chen's Battle Skill and Combo apply Vulnerability, which opens Argent Flow's Combo: one Electric Infliction that WILL-form Arcane's Combo repeats. Bolt Rush consumes both and leaves level-3 Electrification and 3 Sunderization; that Electrification opens Liino's Combo. In the burst, Arcane's Ultimate and Combo add charges, Liino's Ultimate applies Electrification before Bolt Rush and the Crush from Argent Flow's Ultimate detonates the Sunderization.

overview.es: Un equipo híbrido: Chen Qianyu, la sub-DPS física que según el autor pone dos Vulnerability por cada 100 de SP, abre una y otra vez el Combo de Argent Flow, y Arcane en forma WILL duplica su Electric Infliction para que Bolt Rush suba más la Electrification y la Sunderization. Liino sube el ATK de Argent Flow y de Chen, cura y, con su Ultimate, aplica Electrification y Electric Amp. Las dos primeras vueltas son la misma secuencia y dejan, cada una, Electrification de nivel 3 con 3 de Sunderization. En el burst, la Ultimate y el Combo de Arcane suman cargas, se espera a la Electrification de la Ultimate de Liino y Bolt Rush la lleva a nivel 4; Chen cierra con su Finisher y su Ultimate, y la Ultimate de Argent Flow detona la Sunderization con su Crush. El autor le da daño 3,5/5 y dificultad 1/5: es la más fácil de sus dos rotaciones. Tiene una segunda rotación, con Arcane en Hot Work para Corrosion.
overview.en: A hybrid team: Chen Qianyu, the physical sub-DPS that per the author gives two Vulnerability per 100 SP, keeps opening Argent Flow's Combo, and WILL-form Arcane doubles his Electric Infliction so Bolt Rush pushes Electrification and Sunderization higher. Liino raises Argent Flow's and Chen's ATK, heals and, with her Ultimate, applies Electrification and Electric Amp. The first two loops are the same sequence and each leaves level-3 Electrification with 3 Sunderization. In the burst, Arcane's Ultimate and Combo add charges, you wait for the Electrification from Liino's Ultimate and Bolt Rush takes it to level 4; Chen closes with her Finisher and Ultimate, and Argent Flow's Ultimate detonates the Sunderization with its Crush. The author rates it damage 3.5/5 and difficulty 1/5: it is the easier of their two rotations. It has a second rotation, with Arcane on Hot Work for Corrosion.

blurb.es: Argent Flow de carry con Arcane, Antal y Arclight, la opción F2P del autor para quien no tiene a Liino ni a Gilberta. Mismo esquema que su equipo con Gilberta (tres Electric Infliction y Bolt Rush por vuelta, hasta 12 de Sunderization), con un punto fino: preparar el talento de Arclight para que su buff de Electric DMG caiga en el burst. Daño 3,5/5 y dificultad 3/5 en su escala.
blurb.en: Argent Flow as carry with Arcane, Antal and Arclight, the author's F2P option for anyone without Liino or Gilberta. Same scheme as their Gilberta team (three Electric Infliction and Bolt Rush per loop, up to 12 Sunderization), with one fine point: preparing Arclight's talent so her Electric DMG buff lands in the burst. Damage 3.5/5 and difficulty 3/5 on their scale.

whatItDoes.es: Las Battle Skills de Antal y Argent Flow ponen Focus y Vulnerability; el Combo de Argent Flow aplica una Electric Infliction que los de Arcane (forma WILL) y Antal repiten. Bolt Rush convierte las tres en Electrification de nivel 4 y 4 de Sunderization, y abre el Combo de Arclight. La Battle Skill de Arclight consume esa Electrification para cargar su talento, que da Electric DMG al equipo durante 15 s: la última carga se deja para justo antes del burst.
whatItDoes.en: Antal's and Argent Flow's Battle Skills apply Focus and Vulnerability; Argent Flow's Combo applies an Electric Infliction that WILL-form Arcane's and Antal's Combos repeat. Bolt Rush turns all three into level-4 Electrification and 4 Sunderization, and opens Arclight's Combo. Arclight's Battle Skill consumes that Electrification to charge her talent, which gives the team Electric DMG for 15 s: the last charge is saved for right before the burst.

overview.es: Según el autor, Arcane y Antal son los dos mejores apoyos de Arts para Argent Flow: con su Combo, entre los dos repiten su Electric Infliction hasta tres, y así llega a la Sunderization máxima con facilidad. Para el cuarto asiento, la opción F2P en lugar de Liino o Gilberta es Arclight: recupera SP con sus skills, suma daño con Frontiers y su arma, y su Battle Skill consume la Electrification de Argent Flow para cargar su talento Wildland Trekker, que según el autor da hasta un 60% de Electric DMG al equipo. La rotación busca que ese talento caiga en el burst: una Electrification se consume pronto, en la apertura, y la última justo antes del burst; desde ahí hay 15 s para terminarlo. Cada vuelta es la misma idea que con Gilberta: tres Electric Infliction, Bolt Rush para Electrification de nivel 4 y 4 de Sunderization, y en el burst, con la Ultimate de Arcane, las 12. Daño 3,5/5 y dificultad 3/5 en la escala del autor.
overview.en: Per the author, Arcane and Antal are Argent Flow's two best Arts supports: with their Combos they repeat his Electric Infliction up to three, so he reaches maximum Sunderization easily. For the fourth seat, the F2P option instead of Liino or Gilberta is Arclight: she recovers SP with her skills, adds damage with Frontiers and her weapon, and her Battle Skill consumes Argent Flow's Electrification to charge her Wildland Trekker talent, which per the author gives the team up to 60% Electric DMG. The rotation aims for that talent to land in the burst: one Electrification is consumed early, in the opening, and the last one right before the burst; from there you have 15 s to finish it. Every loop is the same idea as with Gilberta: three Electric Infliction, Bolt Rush for level-4 Electrification and 4 Sunderization, and in the burst, with Arcane's Ultimate, the 12. Damage 3.5/5 and difficulty 3/5 on the author's scale.

cons.en: Less damage than with Gilberta or Liino (3.5/5 against 4.5/5 on the author's scale).

body.es: La Battle Skill de Argent Flow aplica Lift y deja Vulnerability, que abre su Combo: una Electric Infliction. El Combo de Arcane en forma WILL añade otra, y el de Antal, que sale cuando el enemigo con Focus sufre una Arts Infliction, una más. Bolt Rush las consume: Electrification de nivel 4 y 4 de Sunderization.
body.en: Argent Flow's Battle Skill applies Lift and leaves Vulnerability, which opens his Combo: one Electric Infliction. WILL-form Arcane's Combo adds another, and Antal's, which fires when the enemy with Focus suffers an Arts Infliction, one more. Bolt Rush consumes them: level-4 Electrification and 4 Sunderization.

body.es: El Combo de Arclight sale cuando el enemigo sufre Electrification o se la consumen, así que Bolt Rush lo abre. Su Battle Skill consume la Electrification para un ataque extra que recupera SP; al hacerlo 3 veces (2 con su potencial 5), su talento da Electric DMG Dealt al equipo según su Intellect durante 15 s, sin acumularse. En la rotación del autor, el talento se activa con la segunda Battle Skill de Arclight.
body.en: Arclight's Combo fires when the enemy suffers Electrification or has it consumed, so Bolt Rush opens it. Her Battle Skill consumes Electrification for an extra attack that recovers SP; after doing it 3 times (2 at her potential 5), her talent gives the team Electric DMG Dealt based on her Intellect for 15 s, without stacking. In the author's rotation, the talent triggers on Arclight's second Battle Skill.

blurb.es: Argent Flow y Avywenna de doble DPS con Arcane y Antal. Según el autor, el kit de Argent Flow encaja perfecto con Avywenna: mantiene al enemigo siempre con Electric Infliction o Electrification, y eso le abre el Combo con cada Final Strike. Daño 4/5 y dificultad 3/5 en su escala: hay que mantener las Vulnerability, terminar el burst antes de que acabe el Imprisonment de Arcane y sacar el máximo de Thunderlances.
blurb.en: Argent Flow and Avywenna as dual DPS with Arcane and Antal. Per the author, Argent Flow's kit fits Avywenna perfectly: he keeps the enemy always under Electric Infliction or Electrification, which opens her Combo on every Final Strike. Damage 4/5 and difficulty 3/5 on their scale: you have to keep the Vulnerability up, finish the burst before Arcane's Imprisonment ends and get the most Thunderlances.

whatItDoes.es: Avywenna controlada. Las Battle Skills de Argent Flow y Antal y sus Combos, con el de Arcane, dejan las Electric Infliction; con eso, cada Final Strike de Avywenna abre su Combo, que clava Thunderlances, y su Battle Skill las recoge. Bolt Rush convierte las Infliction en Electrification y Sunderization y abre otra vez el Combo de Argent Flow. En el burst, las Ultimates de Antal y Arcane, Bolt Rush y las Ultimates de Avywenna y Argent Flow, con la última recogida de Thunderlances.
whatItDoes.en: Avywenna controlled. Argent Flow's and Antal's Battle Skills and Combos, with Arcane's, leave the Electric Infliction; with that, each Avywenna Final Strike opens her Combo, which plants Thunderlances, and her Battle Skill pulls them back. Bolt Rush turns the Infliction into Electrification and Sunderization and reopens Argent Flow's Combo. In the burst, Antal's and Arcane's Ultimates, Bolt Rush and Avywenna's and Argent Flow's Ultimates, with the last Thunderlance recall.

overview.es: Primer equipo del autor con Avywenna de segunda DPS. Según el autor, el kit de Argent Flow encaja perfecto con ella: aplica Electric Infliction con su Combo y Electrification con Bolt Rush, así que el enemigo tiene el debuff todo el tiempo y Avywenna puede sacar su Combo con cada Final Strike. Avywenna va controlada: su Final Strike abre su Combo, que clava un grupo de Thunderlances, y su Battle Skill las recoge cuando hay SP; conviene que la Final Strike caiga justo cuando su Combo está listo (esquivar alarga la cadena de ataques básicos). Arcane y Antal repiten la Electric Infliction de Argent Flow, y Bolt Rush la convierte en Electrification y Sunderization. En el burst, las Ultimates de Antal y Arcane, el último grupo de Thunderlances, Bolt Rush y las Ultimates de Avywenna y Argent Flow, con la Battle Skill de Avywenna recogiendo todas las Thunderlances al final. Daño 4/5 y dificultad 3/5 en la escala del autor: pide timing para mantener las Vulnerability, terminar antes de que acabe el Imprisonment de Arcane y experiencia para sacar el máximo de Thunderlances.
overview.en: The author's first team with Avywenna as second DPS. Per the author, Argent Flow's kit fits her perfectly: he applies Electric Infliction with his Combo and Electrification with Bolt Rush, so the enemy has the debuff all the time and Avywenna can bring out her Combo on every Final Strike. Avywenna is controlled: her Final Strike opens her Combo, which plants a set of Thunderlances, and her Battle Skill pulls them back when there is SP; ideally the Final Strike lands right when her Combo is ready (dodging extends the basic attack chain). Arcane and Antal repeat Argent Flow's Electric Infliction, and Bolt Rush turns it into Electrification and Sunderization. In the burst, Antal's and Arcane's Ultimates, the last set of Thunderlances, Bolt Rush and Avywenna's and Argent Flow's Ultimates, with Avywenna's Battle Skill pulling back every Thunderlance at the end. Damage 4/5 and difficulty 3/5 on the author's scale: it takes timing to keep the Vulnerability up and finish before Arcane's Imprisonment ends, and experience to get the most Thunderlances.

Su Battle Skill recoge las Thunderlances que dejó el Combo, y cada una que impacta le da Ultimate Energy.

Per the author, Argent Flow's kit fits perfectly: his Combo applies Electric Infliction and Bolt Rush, Electrification, so the enemy always has it and Avywenna's Combo is available. Her Battle Skill pulls back the Thunderlances her Combo left, and each one that hits gives her Ultimate Energy.

overview.es: El segundo equipo del autor con Avywenna, y el más accesible: fuera de Argent Flow, todos son operadores estándar de 4 y 5 estrellas. Avywenna va controlada y su Combo sale con cada Final Strike sobre un enemigo con Electric Infliction o Electrification, que Argent Flow mantiene con su Combo y con Bolt Rush; su Battle Skill recoge las Thunderlances y le carga la Ultimate. Antal repite la Electric Infliction de Argent Flow. Arclight ocupa el lugar de Arcane en su otro equipo con Avywenna: su Combo sale con la Electrification y recupera SP, y su Battle Skill consume la Electrification para cargar su talento, que da Electric DMG al equipo durante 15 s. Una carga se consume con el Combo de Argent Flow a 4-5 s de volver; otra, en el burst, junto con el último grupo de Thunderlances y la Ultimate de Antal. Después, las Ultimates de Avywenna y Arclight, Bolt Rush enseguida para convertir las Electric Infliction en Electrification de nivel 4, y la Ultimate de Argent Flow con el Combo de Arclight y la Battle Skill de Avywenna. Daño 3,5/5 y dificultad 2,5/5 en la escala del autor.
overview.en: The author's second team with Avywenna, and the most accessible: apart from Argent Flow, they are all standard 4- and 5-star operators. Avywenna is controlled and her Combo fires on every Final Strike against an enemy with Electric Infliction or Electrification, which Argent Flow keeps up with his Combo and Bolt Rush; her Battle Skill pulls back the Thunderlances and charges her Ultimate. Antal repeats Argent Flow's Electric Infliction. Arclight takes Arcane's place from the author's other Avywenna team: her Combo fires on Electrification and recovers SP, and her Battle Skill consumes Electrification to charge her talent, which gives the team Electric DMG for 15 s. One charge is consumed with Argent Flow's Combo 4-5 s from returning; another, in the burst, together with the last set of Thunderlances and Antal's Ultimate. Then Avywenna's and Arclight's Ultimates, Bolt Rush right away to turn the Electric Infliction into level-4 Electrification, and Argent Flow's Ultimate with Arclight's Combo and Avywenna's Battle Skill. Damage 3.5/5 and difficulty 2.5/5 on the author's scale.

body.es: El Combo de Avywenna sale cuando el operador controlado hace una Final Strike sobre un enemigo con Electric Infliction o Electrification. Según el autor, el kit de Argent Flow encaja perfecto: su Combo pone Electric Infliction y Bolt Rush, Electrification, así que el enemigo la tiene siempre y el Combo de Avywenna está disponible. Su Battle Skill recoge las Thunderlances que dejó el Combo, y cada una que impacta le da Ultimate Energy.
body.en: Avywenna's Combo fires when the controlled operator performs a Final Strike on an enemy with Electric Infliction or Electrification. Per the author, Argent Flow's kit fits perfectly: his Combo applies Electric Infliction and Bolt Rush, Electrification, so the enemy always has it and Avywenna's Combo is available. Her Battle Skill pulls back the Thunderlances her Combo left, and each one that hits gives her Ultimate Energy.

body.es: El Combo de Arclight sale cuando el enemigo sufre Electrification o se la consumen, así que Bolt Rush lo abre. Su Battle Skill consume la Electrification para un ataque extra que recupera SP y carga su talento, que da Electric DMG Dealt al equipo según su Intellect durante 15 s. Su Ultimate aplica Electric Infliction, que Bolt Rush consume enseguida para subir la Electrification.
body.en: Arclight's Combo fires when the enemy suffers Electrification or has it consumed, so Bolt Rush opens it. Her Battle Skill consumes Electrification for an extra attack that recovers SP and charges her talent, which gives the team Electric DMG Dealt based on her Intellect for 15 s. Her Ultimate applies Electric Infliction, which Bolt Rush consumes right away to raise the Electrification.

tip.en: Keep attacking and place Avywenna's Combo every time it is ready.

blurb.es: Argent Flow y Rossi de doble DPS con Arcane y Antal. Los Combos de Argent Flow, Arcane y Antal ponen las Electric Infliction; Bolt Rush las convierte antes de que el Combo de Rossi las consuma. Según el autor, mucho más fácil que su versión con Camille porque no hay que cuidar el orden de skills para el Link. Daño 4/5 y dificultad 3/5 en su escala.
blurb.en: Argent Flow and Rossi as dual DPS with Arcane and Antal. Argent Flow's, Arcane's and Antal's Combos apply the Electric Infliction; Bolt Rush converts them before Rossi's Combo consumes them. Per the author, much easier than their Camille version because there is no skill order to mind for the Link. Damage 4/5 and difficulty 3/5 on their scale.

whatItDoes.es: La Battle Skill de Argent Flow deja Vulnerability y abre su Combo; con el Focus de Antal, su Electric Infliction se repite con los Combos de Arcane (forma WILL) y Antal, y con Vulnerability y Arts Infliction a la vez sale el Combo de Rossi. Bolt Rush convierte las Infliction en Electrification y Sunderization antes de la segunda secuencia de Rossi, que consume lo que quede. Entre vueltas, la Battle Skill de Rossi renueva su Razor Clawmark y abre el Combo de Argent Flow.
whatItDoes.en: Argent Flow's Battle Skill leaves Vulnerability and opens his Combo; with Antal's Focus, his Electric Infliction is repeated by WILL-form Arcane's and Antal's Combos, and with Vulnerability and Arts Infliction together Rossi's Combo fires. Bolt Rush converts the Infliction into Electrification and Sunderization before Rossi's second sequence, which consumes whatever is left. Between loops, Rossi's Battle Skill refreshes her Razor Clawmark and opens Argent Flow's Combo.

overview.es: Argent Flow y Rossi de doble DPS, con los dos mejores apoyos de Arts del autor para Argent Flow: Arcane y Antal. Antes de empezar, el autor pone el Combo de Rossi después de los de Arcane y Antal en el orden de Combos, para controlar mejor la rotación. La Battle Skill de Argent Flow va antes que la de Antal, para que el Combo de Antal no salga antes de tiempo con la Vulnerability. Con los Combos de Argent Flow, Arcane y Antal hay Electric Infliction de sobra y Vulnerability, lo que abre el Combo de Rossi: entre su primera y su segunda secuencia va Bolt Rush, que convierte las Infliction en Electrification y Sunderization antes de que Rossi las consuma. Entre vueltas, la Battle Skill de Rossi renueva su Razor Clawmark y abre el Combo de Argent Flow. El burst junta las Ultimates de Antal y Arcane, Bolt Rush con el Combo de Rossi y cierra con las Ultimates de Argent Flow y Rossi. Daño 4/5 y dificultad 3/5 en la escala del autor, que lo ve mucho más fácil que su doble DPS con Camille.
overview.en: Argent Flow and Rossi as dual DPS, with the author's two best Arts supports for Argent Flow: Arcane and Antal. Before starting, the author places Rossi's Combo after Arcane's and Antal's in the Combo order, to keep the rotation under control. Argent Flow's Battle Skill goes before Antal's, so Antal's Combo does not fire too early on the Vulnerability. With Argent Flow's, Arcane's and Antal's Combos there is plenty of Electric Infliction plus Vulnerability, which opens Rossi's Combo: between her first and second sequence goes Bolt Rush, which turns the Infliction into Electrification and Sunderization before Rossi consumes it. Between loops, Rossi's Battle Skill refreshes her Razor Clawmark and opens Argent Flow's Combo. The burst brings together Antal's and Arcane's Ultimates, Bolt Rush with Rossi's Combo and closes with Argent Flow's and Rossi's Ultimates. Damage 4/5 and difficulty 3/5 on the author's scale, which they find much easier than their dual DPS with Camille.

Por eso Bolt Rush va entre la primera y la segunda: Argent Flow convierte las Electric Infliction en Electrification y Sunderization antes de que Rossi se las lleve.

That is why Bolt Rush goes between the first and the second: Argent Flow turns the Electric Infliction into Electrification and Sunderization before Rossi takes it.

Si su Focus está puesto antes del Lift de la Battle Skill de Argent Flow, el Combo sale con eso y repite Vulnerability; con la Battle Skill de Antal después, sale con la Electric Infliction del Combo de Argent Flow.

If his Focus is up before the Lift from Argent Flow's Battle Skill, the Combo fires on that and repeats Vulnerability; with Antal's Battle Skill after, it fires on the Electric Infliction from Argent Flow's Combo.

Her Battle Skill applies Lift and, if there is already Vulnerability, unleashes a Heat attack that leaves Razor Clawmark (more Physical and Heat damage taken).

deepNote.es: Su Battle Skill pone Focus. Su Combo sale cuando el enemigo con Focus sufre un Physical Status o una Arts Infliction y aplica otra acumulación del mismo: va después de la Electric Infliction del Combo de Argent Flow, o repite una Vulnerability.
deepNote.en: His Battle Skill applies Focus. His Combo fires when the enemy with Focus suffers a Physical Status or an Arts Infliction and applies another stack of the same: it goes after the Electric Infliction from Argent Flow's Combo, or it repeats a Vulnerability.

intro.es: Builds de los paneles del autor en el video, leídas en alta resolución. Cada demo empieza con 0 de Ultimate Energy contra un objetivo, y el autor quita esencias o cambia armas para no matar al jefe antes de tiempo.
intro.en: Builds from the author's panels in the video, read at high resolution. Every demo starts at 0 Ultimate Energy against a single target, and the author removes essences or swaps weapons so the boss does not die too early.
